# CSV Grid Editor

> A VS Code extension (Marketplace id `bash-365.csv-grid-viewer`) that opens CSV, TSV, TAB and PSV files in a spreadsheet-style grid on top of the text document. It has editing with native undo and save, Excel-style AutoFilter, column statistics, charts, in-memory SQLite queries, and re-runnable data pipelines. Everything runs locally. CSV and TSV files open as text by default; the grid is opt-in via "Open in Grid Editor".
